precision_policy: Working DEFF1.5 for reported unweighted bases; 2 for reported weighted/unspecified bases;3 for rounded-composition estimates and published suppression lower bounds. Source-informed larger effects override defaults; reported effective bases use DEFF1. Exact source bases retained; fractional model counts floored. These are provisional assumptions, not empirically calibrated guarantees.
limitations: Search coverage is documented, not a proof all public polls were found. Inaccessible, paywalled, missing/suppressed-group and unresolved sources are itemized per race.
Party-ID lean definitions and Independent/Other combinations vary by publisher. Actual registration is a labeled fallback; several party-basis interpretations are explicit inferences.
Published subgroup suppression bounds are model precision limits, never actual sample sizes; derived bases use rounded matching-population composition, not reported subgroup interviews.
Censored support, unknown party classification, unresolved material table/article conflicts, and complete tables without defensible precision remain held.
No historical calibration or forecast accuracy claim follows from a successful software replay.
